messages:
maria: heads-up: nightly eval flagged a spike after pset v29 merged — qualifier-ordering looks suspicious
evalbot: nightly-eval · pset_v29 · 1749992222
evalbot: metrics: failures=198 / 3600 (5.50%) vs prev 1.9%
maria: fail mode concentrated in the 'qualifier-ordering' suite, rerank_qa and ordering-sensitive intent cases
lena: did someone change the template text? even small reorders can matter for some models
ajay: I pulled the diff: they swapped Audience and Tone in the prompt header, tiny reorder
maria: snippet: ```
- Context: {context}. Tone: {tone}. Audience: {audience}. Task: {task}
+ Context: {context}. Audience: {audience}. Tone: {tone}. Task: {task}
```
sam: small but plausible. which models show the biggest delta? canary/quantized?
lena: canary-v2 and quantized-canary both show +2.6-3.1% rerank failures when run locally, matches nightly trend
ajay: running a focused eval: `eval-run --suite qualifier-ordering --model canary-v2 --samples 600` — will post summary
ops-bot: infra alert: canary pool CPU usage +6% during nightly run (investigating) :mag_right:
ajay: results: reproduces. rerank_qa failure +2.9%, intent ordering flips concentrated on ~120 sample ids, pushing different token prefixes
maria: creating a temporary revert to stop bleed while we root cause
maria: PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/4999 — revert pset v29 ordering change
ajay: dumping failing samples to issue for clustering: INFR-2410 — attached tokenized traces and rerank deltas
lena: will run ablation: move just Audience earlier in a few variants to see whether it's position or phrasing that triggers flips
sam: long-term we should gate promptpack PRs with an auto-eval check: block if delta > 0.5% on any core suite
maria: agreed. can we add a pre-merge CI hook to run `eval-run --pset-diff`? devex we need guidance on thresholds
ajay: I'll draft a gating rule and a lightweight ablation harness to attach to PRs. posting in #devex today
lena: for RCA next: cluster failures by token overlap, initial attention token, and rerank score delta; also compare quantized vs fp runs to see sensitivity
maria: merge revert on CI green. follow-up: schedule a rollback postmortem with samples and proposed gating changes
sam: thanks. after revert, let's do an A/B with rephrased prompt (add explicit labels like "Audience:" token) rather than pure reorder
maria: noted. will coordinate canary A/B once PR lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
